tok 1.0 "IT request handling"

pool org "Organisation"
  lane requester "Employee or department"
    start begin "Request needed"
    task submit "Submit the request for an IT solution"
    task rollout_recv "Receive the new solution"
  lane it "IT"
    task assess "Assess the request"
    xor approved "Approved?"
    task procure "Procure the tools or licenses"
    task install "Install the solution"
    task test "Test the solution"
    xor passed "Test successful?"
    task rollout "Roll out the solution to the requesting department"
    xor training "Training needed?"
    task train "Provide training"
    xor merge
    task support "Provide IT support for troubleshooting"
    end done "Request fulfilled"
    end rejected "Request rejected"
    end failed "Solution not accepted"

flow begin -> submit -> assess -> approved
flow approved -> procure "yes"
flow approved -> rejected "no"
flow procure -> install -> test -> passed
flow passed -> rollout "yes"
flow passed -> failed "no"
flow rollout -> rollout_recv -> training
flow training -> train "yes"
flow training -> merge "no"
flow train -> merge
flow merge -> support -> done
